function.name: osint_auto_hunt
function.description: PASSIVE MODE (RUN IMMEDIATELY WITH ZERO QUESTIONS). Executes an exhaustive multi-stage passive OSINT hunt on any selector, file path, URL, or natural-language prompt with zero direct packets to target servers.

target.description: Raw target selector, URL, file path, or natural-language prompt.

depth.description: Exhaustive multi-stage surface expansion depth until 0 new leads remain (default: 4).

function.name: osint_ingest_and_expand_case
function.description: PASSIVE MULTI-STAGE EXPANSION (ZERO QUESTIONS). Ingest ALL raw findings from a stage (web_search snippets, bios, Linktrees, directories) into an existing case, carve EVERY new clue, and hunt ALL of them across subsequent stages until convergence.

case_id_or_dir.description: Existing CASE_ID or case directory path.

ingested_text.description: All raw text, URLs, bios, and contact strings gathered during the stage.

function.name: osint_prepare_active_hunt
function.description: STEP 1 OF ACTIVE MODE (SENDS ZERO PACKETS). Generates a single-use `request_id` and OPSEC disclosure plan for Active OSINT across target or `from_case`. You MUST stop and ask the user for explicit approval after calling this function before calling `osint_execute_active_hunt`.

target.description: Target domain, URL, IP, or selector.

from_case.description: Optional CASE_ID to auto-extract ALL domains/IPs discovered across passive stages.

function.name: osint_execute_active_hunt
function.description: STEP 2 OF ACTIVE MODE (HARD GATED). Executes direct TCP/TLS/HTTP/DNS active reconnaissance ONLY AFTER `osint_prepare_active_hunt` was shown to the user and the user explicitly replied approving it.

user_confirmation.description: Verbatim quote of the user's message authorizing active probing.

function.name: osint_forensic_decode
function.description: ZERO-NETWORK FORENSIC & CHRONOLOCATION DECODER. Decodes TikTok video/post IDs & URLs (upload UTC), Discord/X Snowflakes, UUIDv1 (MAC + 100ns time), UUIDv6/v7, ULIDs, MongoDB ObjectIds, ISO 13616 IBANs (SAMA), E.164 phones (US/UK/GCC/MENA), VINs, ICAO24, IMO/MMSI, MAC/BSSIDs, JWTs, and local files.

payload.description: Token, ID, IBAN, phone, VIN, MAC, TikTok/Snowflake URL, UUID/ULID/ObjectId, or local file path.

function.name: osint_compare_cases
function.description: CROSS-CASE LINK ANALYSIS. Compares two saved CASE-... investigations to uncover shared entities, shared root domains, shared /24 IPv4 subnets, and shared analytics/tracking tags.

function.name: osint_query_arsenal
function.description: Search the 760-tool OSINT Monster Database (559 Passive + 201 Active/Hybrid) by input selector, discipline, keyword, or passive/free filters.

function.name: osint_forge_dorks
function.description: Generate target-substituted Google, Shodan, Censys, FOFA, ZoomEye, URLScan, and GitHub dorks (105 templates).
